redundancy_policy: Each completed packet must have an authoritative-source receipt, a Hugging Face immutable revision, and an independent Internet Archive item or a recorded exception.

sources.scope: all published notice metadata and content
sources.ingest_path: DigitalNZ Gazette export or Gazette API
sources.primary_target: Hugging Face curated Gazette dataset in this repository
sources.release_rule: CC BY 3.0 NZ attribution with source exclusions and takedown/redaction reconciliation
blockers: Configure DIGITALNZ_API_KEY or an approved Gazette API credential as a repository environment secret
Configure Internet Archive upload credentials as repository environment secrets

sources.scope: all exposed record metadata, biographies, linked documents, and media representations
sources.ingest_path: Cenotaph search index plus resolvable /id and /id/media resources
sources.release_rule: Full preservation is authorized; public release must retain source rights fields and honour takedown, cultural, privacy, and media-specific restrictions
sources.rate_limit: 1000 /id or /id/media requests per day; resume from a content-addressed checkpoint

inventory_evidence.scroll_start: POST /search/cenotaph/_search?scroll=1m with an Elasticsearch match_all body
inventory_evidence.scroll_continuation: POST /search/_search/scroll with scroll and scroll_id JSON fields
inventory_evidence.continuation_status: Verified in browser context; the hosted non-browser client remains blocked by HTTP 403

blockers: Auckland Museum must allow hosted archival clients to access the verified search and scroll routes
Configure Internet Archive upload credentials as repository environment secrets

sources.scope: all Papers Past material published before 1945
sources.ingest_path: National Library Papers Past open-data bulk distribution, with item/page provenance retained
sources.release_rule: Full preservation is authorized; publish only according to retained item rights, including distinct treatment of third-party and Māori material
blockers: Record the current official National Library Papers Past bulk-distribution URL and item/page provenance format
Configure Internet Archive upload credentials as repository environment secrets
